findings.clause: erp-core checklist C7: "Every byte goes through FilePrivateStoreApi / FileImageStoreApi / the FILE endpoints; the module keeps FILE_DOCUMENT.ID columns and asks FileDocumentLookupApi for URLs" · F9 (workaround instead of CORE-GAP) · modules.file 'Do not rebuild: … an image validator'
findings.problem: PHASE CORE 'Given usage', API-CAT-018 (RULE-CAT-038) and API-CAT-049 (RULE-CAT-044) all assume CAT can read the type, size and storage (public or private) of a fileDocumentRef through FileDocumentLookupApi, and the bytes of an import file. Both conventions.md §Files and file.md publish only isAvailable, publicUrl and publicUrls on that interface, and no in-process byte read-back exists. CAT's own JPG/PNG/WEBP and 5 MB check is also the 'image validator' that file.md lists under 'Do not rebuild'; FILE_CATEGORY already carries per-tenant limits and allowPublic. As written, RULE-CAT-038, RULE-CAT-044 and the whole import (REQ-CAT-037 … 041, 139) depend on calls that do not exist, and no CORE-GAP records this. This breaks a given-checklist line, which makes it MAJOR and forces REVISE. Re-check in this round: confirmed against .claude/skills/erp-core-usage@1.6.0/reference/conventions.md:77 and modules/file.md.
findings.fix: 1) Raise decisions/CAT/CORE-GAP-file-document-metadata-read.md. It asks whether FileDocumentLookupApi (or FilePrivateStoreApi) can return a document's content type, size and visibility, and give a bounded read of a private document's bytes, within the caller's tenant. 2) Raise a new ADR amending ADR-CAT-056: image type, size and public-only storage are enforced by the FILE category CAT registers for item images (allowPublic = true, allowed types PNG/JPEG/WEBP, limit 5 MB), at the given FILE upload endpoint. CAT then checks only isAvailable and its own 20-record count (RULE-CAT-038 keeps its message for the count, and the ADR states which part the FILE category holds). The import's byte read and its type/size check are marked as a core dependency until the gap is answered. 3) Correct the FileDocumentLookupApi given-usage rows in SRS A9, contract §4 and the backend plan PHASE CORE so they list only the published methods. Add the gap to 'Core gaps' and to the plan index. 4) Add a PLATFORM FINDINGS row in business-policies (owner erp-core modules.file). 5) Re-word TC-CAT-056, 146, 166 and 218: type, size and storage refusals come from the FILE category upload, and the CAT endpoint is asserted only for what CAT itself decides (isAvailable → CAT-404-NOT-FOUND, the count → RULE-CAT-038).

findings.clause: rubric: complete (P1 silent path; P4 one rule for a repeated defect)
findings.problem: The plan never says what happens when a request body is well-typed but contradicts itself, or names a record outside the addressed parent. The same gap appears in four places: (a) API-CAT-006 with an attribute listed twice in `selections`, a duplicate id in `variantAttributeValueFks`, or a value of another attribute — these reach UQ_CAT_VAR_ATTR_ASSIGN_ATTR or the composite FK FK_CAT_VAR_ATTR_ASSIGN_CAT_VAR_ATTR_VALUE, which have no catalog row and so surface as CAT-500; (b) API-CAT-001 with a non-empty `bundleComponents` on a STANDARD Item; (c) API-CAT-017 with a bundleComponentPk of another Bundle, or a kept line whose componentVariantFk changed (DBF-CAT-089 is read-only after create); (d) API-CAT-014 is covered only for INTERNAL. Each implementer would pick a different outcome (ignore, 500 or save), and no TC exercises any of these cases.
findings.fix: Add one rule to PHASE CORE 'API conventions': a request whose fields contradict each other, or that names a record not part of the addressed parent, is refused with CAT-400-REQUEST-INVALID before any RULE runs and writes nothing. This covers a duplicate attribute or value id, a value not of its attribute, bundleComponents on a STANDARD Item, a bundleComponentPk outside the Bundle, and a changed componentVariantFk on a kept line. Also state that every db constraint backing a RULE is translated to that RULE's catalog row, never to CAT-500. Cite the rule in the Validations of API-CAT-001, 006, 014, 015 and 017, and extend the CAT-400-REQUEST-INVALID trigger text in the Error Catalog. Add one parameterised backend TC (package SVC-API-CRUD, one row per case) that asserts 400 and no write.
